visual_policy: All visuals are candidates pending attribution, rights, and editorial review. A.M.I.N.A. plate needs fresh publication review.

lessons.title: Give the agent a job and a receipt
lessons.learning_outcome: Define one bounded job and the receipt that would make its work reviewable.
lessons.exercise: Describe a familiar workflow; mark its owner, inputs, output, and first receipt.
lessons.evidence_boundary: Use a synthetic workflow; omit actual prompts, identities, and private work traces.

lessons.title: Start with the decision
lessons.learning_outcome: Name the human decision the agent prepares and the consequence of a wrong answer.
lessons.exercise: Write a Decision Card with decision owner, alternatives, evidence, and stop condition.
lessons.evidence_boundary: Use invented facts; never imply the agent owns the final decision.

lessons.title: Trace the work and grade the sources
lessons.learning_outcome: Specify trace fields and safe source tiers for the same workflow.
lessons.exercise: Draw one path from source to artifact to human review; classify each sample source.
lessons.evidence_boundary: Use mock source IDs; keep private corpus and operational trace data outside the course.

lessons.title: Turn feedback into governed memory
lessons.learning_outcome: Separate source, event, proposal, approved memory, and controller routing.
lessons.exercise: Route one feedback item and reject an unsupported memory proposal.
lessons.evidence_boundary: Use synthetic feedback; Open Brain records are architecture examples, not learner data.

lessons.title: Map the operating system
lessons.learning_outcome: Draw where the workflow runs, who approves it, and where evidence lives.
lessons.exercise: Place the job, decision, source, receipt, memory, and owner on one map.
lessons.evidence_boundary: Use a generic stack; do not reveal Portfolio internal topology or credentials.

lessons.title: Write the permission slip
lessons.learning_outcome: Bound reads, writes, retention, and the work worth retiring.
lessons.exercise: Mark permitted actions and remove one low-value agent task from the map.
lessons.evidence_boundary: Treat examples as proposals; no live permission changes or deletion.

lessons.title: Specify the work and the team
lessons.learning_outcome: Describe requirements, roles, ownership, and failure handoffs.
lessons.exercise: Draft a short PRD and assign each step to a named role and human owner.
lessons.evidence_boundary: Use role labels only; no production agent configuration.

lessons.title: Make handoffs testable
lessons.learning_outcome: Define a handoff contract and a small evaluation set before authority grows.
lessons.exercise: Write input/output checks, then grade three synthetic cases including a failure.
lessons.evidence_boundary: Cases are invented; passing a classroom eval grants no production authority.

lessons.title: Measure trust and choose review posture
lessons.learning_outcome: Track quality, burden, cost, and review strength for the workflow.
lessons.exercise: Choose measures and assign review posture to low, medium, and high-risk actions.
lessons.evidence_boundary: Do not use customer metrics or claim a live performance baseline.

lessons.title: Gate spend and brief the decision
lessons.learning_outcome: Set a cost ceiling and prepare a human decision with evidence and options.
lessons.exercise: Build a mock spend envelope and a decision brief that can end in hold.
lessons.evidence_boundary: No payment, provider activation, or real spending; numbers are illustrative.

lessons.title: Run the cockpit and unblock lane
lessons.learning_outcome: Show status, blockers, owner, and the next authorized step in one view.
lessons.exercise: Sketch a cockpit card and a mobile unblock message for the same job.
lessons.evidence_boundary: No Slack messages or live task records; use fictional status data.

lessons.title: Prove the work safely
lessons.learning_outcome: Package scoped proof and test an idea without leaking the underlying record.
lessons.exercise: Redact a fictional trace and score a mock app concept against the workflow.
lessons.evidence_boundary: No client data, private screenshots, or public claims of deployment.

lessons.title: Research with a gate
lessons.learning_outcome: Record an experiment hypothesis, metric, and proposed next test without automatic promotion.
lessons.exercise: Write one hypothesis and a proposal packet from synthetic results.
lessons.evidence_boundary: No provider calls, autonomous loops, or promotion into durable memory.

lessons.title: Show the board the controls
lessons.learning_outcome: Explain the workflow, its gate, and its evidence to a skeptical reviewer.
lessons.exercise: Storyboard three panels: work, authority, and proof.
lessons.evidence_boundary: Illustrative demo only; no claim that a production control was exercised.

lessons.title: Rehearse the agentified day
lessons.learning_outcome: Walk the bounded job through a day, including a block and a human decision.
lessons.exercise: Rehearse six beats and record what stops when a receipt or approval is missing.
lessons.evidence_boundary: Synthetic timeline; no real agent run or externally visible action.

lessons.title: Audit the operating file
lessons.learning_outcome: Audit the full workflow, identify the weakest gate, and decide whether to keep, shrink, or retire it.
lessons.exercise: Present the Operating File with missing evidence made visible and an explicit human disposition.
lessons.evidence_boundary: Capstone is a design review, not approval to deploy, publish, spend, or execute.
